'''Cryle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Cryle was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]], Cryle was the oldest of his clan mates and was a callous and brash boy, with a disregard for the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]].<ref name="YOUNG" />

While the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Cryle and his fellow students [[Ammon]] and [[Tryla (Jedi Initiate)|Tryla]] accompanied [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a training [[Mission to unidentified planet (Younglings)|mission]] to a jungle [[Unidentified planet (Younglings)|planet]]. There, Cryle constantly harassed Ammon before being admonished for this by Skywalker.<ref name="YOUNG" />
